hard_constraints.NO_SOURCE_REVISION_SUBSTITUTION: ENFORCED (local HEAD == pinned SHA verified per asset)

source_freeze_verification.fetch_mode: git shallow fetch of exact pinned SHA (--depth 1), per-asset bare init
source_freeze_verification.byte_faithful_checkout: core.autocrlf=false, core.eol=lf; git status --porcelain empty vs HEAD asserted
source_freeze_verification.note: Tree hashes are intrinsic Git identities of the pinned commits; naturally identical to what SE10 verifies its source pack against. No SE10 pack files consulted.

evidence_integrity_incidents.detail: A background-task supervisor re-executed the round-2 LibreOffice attempt while the first instance was still running; the duplicate's script-start truncated the shared logs/apt.log (first instance's successful dpkg history lost). Duplicates were killed (container exit 137). The supervisor then re-invoked the same payload detached (scripts/attempt-libreoffice-round2b.sh, docker run -d + docker wait, container name se11-lo-r2b); that instance ran the full sequence to completion and its autogen/attempt-final outputs are the authoritative round-2 evidence (attempt.log: LIBREOFFICE_ROUND2B_EXIT=1).
evidence_integrity_incidents.effect: apt.log reflects only the final instance's stream; the decisive configure evidence (autogen.log, attempt-final.txt) is coherent with the final instance.

evidence_integrity_incidents.detail: Initial fetch inherited core.autocrlf=true; FFmpeg ./configure failed with 'cannot execute: required file not found'. All four sources were re-materialized byte-faithfully (autocrlf=false, eol=lf) and ALL committed build/smoke evidence comes from the byte-faithful trees.
evidence_integrity_incidents.effect: Committed artifact hashes (minio 94d0b267..., pandas wheel e57b0784..., ffmpeg fb2e2c68...) correspond to byte-faithful checkouts.

container_attempt.method: bounded rounds with documented dependency waves and default-feature ./autogen.sh; per-round timeout 1500s; final round = round 2
container_attempt.round0_exact_error: configure: error: Could not find CUPS. Install libcups2-dev or cups-devel. (Error running configure at ./autogen.sh line 338; autogen_exit=1)
container_attempt.round1_disposition: INVALID_ATTEMPT: sole failed apt archive was openjdk-21-jdk-headless (connection failed to security.ubuntu.com), which aborted the whole apt transaction — libcups2-dev was never installed; superseded by round 2. Raw driver log preserved (logs/libreoffice/round1-driver.log).
container_attempt.round2_exact_error: After libcups2-dev/GTK3/X11 were installed (configure passed the CUPS check: 'checking for cupsPrintFiles in -lcups... yes'), configure failed at: 'The missing Perl modules are: Archive::Zip' (autogen.sh line 338; autogen_exit=1).
container_attempt.round3_terminal_error: TERMINAL round: after adding libarchive-zip-perl (Archive::Zip fixed), configure progressed through STL/ccache/visibility checks and failed at: 'checking for java... no; configure: error: Java not found. You need at least JDK 8' (autogen.sh line 338; autogen_exit=1). Three successive mandatory dependencies remediated (CUPS, Archive::Zip), each revealing the next; terminal by pre-declared stop rule.
container_attempt.rounds_verdict: BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT — within Stage-A budget the exact pinned revision does not reach a runnable binding on this host: the default-feature build path mandates a long dependency chain (CUPS -> Perl Archive::Zip -> JDK 8+) and, past it, a multi-hour tens-of-GB make. NO substitution performed; NO feature-reduced configure substituted for the default path.

assets.budget_facts: source checkout 1.8 GB (54 GB free host disk); full LO core build is a multi-hour, tens-of-GB job on this 16-thread host — beyond Stage-A session budget; a configure success would still NOT be a runnable binding within this freeze
assets.substitution: NONE — no distro LibreOffice, no newer upstream, no feature-reduced configure masquerading as the pinned revision
assets.se11_binding_path: UNAVAILABLE until a dedicated build session produces a pinned-revision binary; Stage B must treat LibreOffice claims as BLOCKED unless such a binding exists
